name: jordan-doerksen.github.io
statusNote: Actively being redesigned; two design generations (Daybreak Editorial and the older Observatory) currently coexist mid-migration.
oneLiner: The portfolio monorepo itself — the site this atlas lives on, documenting the site that documents it.
stack: Plain HTML/CSS/vanilla JS — no build tools, no npm, no framework
Content as JSON under data/, fetched at runtime

components.name: Root portfolio
components.desc: index.html — document-shaped front door: TOC, numbered principles, three flagship case studies, full project index.

components.name: 7 category hubs
components.desc: rail/, games/, trading/, studio/, signals/, bots/, tools/ — thin shells that fetch the registry and render cards client-side.

components.name: Project pages
components.desc: Every project's page lives inside its category folder in this same repo.

components.name: data/registry.json
components.desc: Single source of truth for categories and project cards.

components.name: styles/
components.desc: Copied Daybreak Editorial snapshot: tokens.css, style.css, effects.js.

components.name: Redirect stubs
components.desc: One-line meta-refresh pages keeping every old top-level URL alive.

components.name: Legacy Observatory layer
components.desc: Prior-generation css/js and spoke pages, still present mid-migration.

dataFlow: data/registry.json holds categories and one object per project.
The root page fetches it and renders the category summary plus a full grouped archive list.
Each hub fetches it, filters projects by its hardcoded category, and renders one card per match.
A card links to its in-repo url, falls back to the external repo, else renders unlinked as private.
effects.js is injected after cards exist in the DOM so reveal and hover effects bind to fresh elements.
Adding a project is one JSON object appended to the registry — no hub code changes.
integrations: A free public quote API with a local JSON fallback
Cross-links to every standalone project repo
decisions: No build tools for the shell layer, ever.
Registry-driven categories instead of hand-coded hub HTML.
Per-repo GitHub Pages off everywhere except this monorepo (plus Resume and style-library).
Redirect stubs preserve every old URL.
Cards with no url or repo render explicitly as private — show nothing rather than something false.
Effects script deliberately injected post-render so it binds to freshly created cards.
